expectations.text: Detects Python/Django — wiki.config.yaml lists language='python' and framework='django' with at least one evidence file cited in detection-trace (requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, or manage.py)
expectations.evidence: wiki.config.yaml lines 6-7: `language: python`, `framework: django`. detection-trace.md Phase 1 cites marker files `requirements.txt` (Django>=4.2, djongo, pymongo verbatim), `manage.py`, and `myapp/settings.py`.

expectations.text: Detects Django ORM — ecosystem.orm.profiles includes 'django' AND the detection trace names at least one extracted model class with its db_table mapping (e.g., Article → articles)
expectations.evidence: wiki.config.yaml lines 38-41 set `ecosystem.orm.enabled: true` and `profiles: [django]`. detection-trace.md Phase 2 extracts `class Article(models.Model)` with `db_table = "articles"`, giving the exact Article → articles mapping the eval requires, plus columns title/body.

expectations.text: Detects MongoDB — wiki.config.yaml's database block sets driver='mongodb' (via djongo or direct) with connection info parsed from settings.py (e.g., mongodb://localhost:27017)
expectations.evidence: wiki.config.yaml lines 17-29: `database.enabled: true`, `driver: mongodb`, environments.dev with host localhost, port 27017, database mydb, connection_uri `mongodb://localhost:27017`, source `myapp/settings.py (DATABASES[default] via djongo)`. detection-trace.md Phase 3 shows the parsed DATABASES stanza.

expectations.text: Policy stanza (block_ddl, block_privilege, dml_mode, audit.enabled) is populated for MongoDB
expectations.evidence: wiki.config.yaml lines 30-37: `policy.block_ddl: true`, `block_privilege: true`, `dml_mode: present_only`, `escalate_unbounded_reads: true`, `audit.enabled: true`, path ~/.wiki/db_audit.jsonl. Mirrored and annotated in detection-trace.md Phase 3.

expectations.text: Wiki scaffold (wiki/, raw/, graph/, audit/, log/, outputs/) exists at the configured wiki_root
expectations.evidence: wiki-scaffold-tree.txt shows all six required dirs at root /tmp/eval-i3-onboard-django: wiki/ (with claims, synthesis, templates), raw/, graph/, audit/ (open, resolved), log/ (daily), outputs/ (queries, reports). events.jsonl init event lists all 12 created_dirs.

expectations.text: Seed files (wiki/index.md, graph/edges.jsonl, log/events.jsonl) exist — not just empty directories
expectations.evidence: seed-files-check.md confirms all three as regular files: wiki/index.md (27 bytes, '# Index\n\nWiki entry point.'), graph/edges.jsonl (0 bytes but a real file via touchFile), log/events.jsonl (769 bytes, 2 events). events.jsonl init event's created_files array explicitly lists all three.

claims.claim: Article model maps to 'articles' table via explicit Meta.db_table, overriding the profile's snake_case_plural default
claims.evidence: detection-trace.md Phase 2 cites `db_table = "articles"` at line 9 of myapp/models.py; pattern from django.yaml matched.

claims.claim: init_wiki.ts created edges.jsonl as a real 0-byte file via touchFile() so append-only writers avoid ENOENT
claims.evidence: seed-files-check.md describes the mechanism; events.jsonl init event lists graph/edges.jsonl in created_files.
detection-trace.md Commands executed section shows parse_config.js was run and '# validates cleanly'. Config is well-formed YAML with all expected top-level keys.

claims.claim: ENGINE='djongo' plus mongodb:// CLIENT host resolves driver to mongodb
claims.evidence: detection-trace.md Phase 3 shows the settings.py DATABASES dict and the djongo→mongodb inference; matches the driver field in wiki.config.yaml.

suggestions.assertion: Seed files (wiki/index.md, graph/edges.jsonl, log/events.jsonl) exist — not just empty directories
suggestions.reason: The assertion permits graph/edges.jsonl to be empty, which is reasonable, but a stronger version could require at least one init/onboard event in log/events.jsonl (as produced here) — otherwise a no-op touch satisfies the check. The skill already writes structured events, so the bar could be raised cheaply.

No assertion checks that the Article model's columns (title, body) were extracted, even though the trace reports them. A targeted assertion on column extraction would catch an ORM agent that identifies the class+table but fails on field parsing — a plausible partial-failure mode.

No assertion verifies the ORM mapping was actually cross-validated (or would be) against the MongoDB driver — ecosystem.orm.cross_validate_against_db is set to true but nothing tests whether the two detection results are consistent (e.g., mongodb collection name matches db_table).

eval_feedback.overall: Evals are solid and discriminating — each assertion requires real substance (frontmatter values AND evidence, ORM profile AND extracted mapping, driver AND connection URI, policy fields AND audit.enabled, scaffold dirs AND non-empty seed files). Minor tightening opportunities around column extraction and cross-validation, but not gaps.
